settings.config-folder-desc: Settings, plugins, themes and snippets of this vault live in its .sk_notes folder.
settings.about-text: sk_notes is part of Skorpion OS. Everything stays on your computer: no account, no telemetry. The only network connection is to your local SKAI (Ollama). Licensed under GPL-3.0. sk_notes is not affiliated with Obsidian or Dynalist Inc.
settings.default-view-desc: Open notes in editing or reading view.
settings.default-editing-desc: Live Preview hides the Markdown syntax outside the line you are editing; Source mode always shows it.
settings.readable-desc: Limit the width of the text column.
settings.inline-title-desc: Show the file name as an editable title at the top of the note.
settings.wrap-desc: Long lines continue on the next visual line.
settings.properties-desc: How the properties at the top of a note are shown.
settings.autopair-desc: Typing an opening bracket or quote also inserts the closing one.
settings.fold-desc: Show fold arrows next to headings and list items.
settings.slash-desc: Type / at the start of a word to run a command.
settings.new-file-location-desc: Where newly created notes are placed.
settings.same-folder: Same folder as the current file
settings.new-file-folder-desc: Used when the option above is "In the folder below".
settings.attachments-desc: Where pasted and dropped files go. "/" = vault root, "./" = same folder as the note, "./name" = subfolder of the note's folder.
settings.update-links-desc: When a file is renamed or moved, update the links that point to it.
settings.deleted-files-desc: What happens to files you delete.
settings.import-notes-desc: Bring notes in from other apps (Evernote, Notion, Bear, Logseq, Roam, Google Keep, HTML, CSV…).
settings.migrate-desc: Read the settings of an existing vault (hotkeys, appearance, plugins) and offer to import them. The original files are never changed.
settings.base-theme-desc: "Follow SKAI" uses the theme chosen in the SKAI apps.
settings.font-size-desc: Size of the text of notes, in pixels.
settings.text-font-desc: CSS font family for notes. Empty = default.
settings.show-ribbon-desc: The vertical bar of actions on the left.
settings.snippets-desc: CSS files in .sk_notes/snippets. Turn them on below.

settings.hotkeys-conflict: This hotkey is also used by: {names}
settings.daily-folder-desc: New daily notes go in this folder.
settings.daily-template-desc: Note used as template for new daily notes.
settings.templates-folder-desc: Notes in this folder are offered by "Insert template".
settings.preview-mod: Require Ctrl to preview in the editor
settings.preview-mod-desc: Hovering a link shows the linked note; in the editor, hold Ctrl.
settings.git-desc: Commit, pull and push the vault with Git. No external service is required.
settings.publish-desc: Generate a website from your notes in a local folder.

bases.filter-help: Filters use the base expression language, for example: file.hasTag("book"), status == "done", price > 10. Use and / or / not lists to combine them.
canvas.help-text: Double-click empty space: new card. Drag from a card's side dot: new connection. Space or Ctrl + wheel: zoom. Middle or right button drag: move around. Delete: remove selection.
canvas.invalid: This canvas file is not valid JSON. Fix it as text or restore an earlier version from the version history.
canvas.link-offline: Web pages are not loaded inside sk_notes (offline). Click to open in the browser.

import.title: Import notes
import.intro: Converts notes from other apps into Markdown files in this vault. The source files are only read. Nothing is sent over the network.
import.folder-desc: Folder inside the vault where imported notes go.
import.hint.markdown: A folder of .md files and attachments, copied as it is.
import.hint.enex: An .enex file exported from Evernote, or a folder of them.
import.hint.notion: The .zip file of a Notion "Markdown & CSV" export, or its extracted folder.
import.hint.html: An HTML file or a folder of HTML files.
import.hint.textbundle: .textbundle / .textpack files exported from Bear or other apps, or a folder of them.
import.hint.logseq: The folder of a Logseq graph (with pages/ and journals/).
import.hint.roam: The JSON export of a Roam Research graph.
import.hint.keep: The Keep folder of a Google Takeout export.
import.hint.csv: A CSV file: every row becomes a note, the first column is the title, the others become properties.

migration.title: Settings from another app
migration.intro: This vault contains the settings folder (.obsidian) of another Markdown app. sk_notes can copy the settings you choose into its own .sk_notes folder. The original folder and your notes are only read, never changed.
migration.nothing: No settings to import were found.
migration.found: This vault has settings from another Markdown app.
migration.plugins-warning: Plugins are third-party code. They are copied but only run after you turn off restricted mode.
migration.done: {n} groups of settings imported. Restart sk_notes to apply them?
plugins.warning-text: Community plugins are programs written by other people. They run inside sk_notes with access to your notes. sk_notes asks before a plugin uses files outside the vault, runs programs, uses the network or opens external links, but only install plugins you trust.
plugins.restricted-desc: While on, no community plugin runs.
plugins.install-desc: From a folder with manifest.json and main.js, or from the release of a GitHub repository.
plugins.github-confirm: Download the latest release of {repo} from GitHub? This is the only time sk_notes goes on the network for this.
plugins.uninstall-confirm: Uninstall {name}? Its settings are deleted too.

plugins.no-class: The plugin file does not export a plugin.
plugins.permissions-desc: "Ask" shows a question the first time the plugin needs the permission.

publish.only-marked-desc: Include only notes with the property publish: true.

sync.intro: sk_notes has no sync servers. You can sync the vault yourself with Git or Syncthing; this panel helps with both.
sync.git-init-desc: Start versioning this vault with Git. Caches of sk_notes are excluded.

skai.settings-intro: SKAI is the local AI of Skorpion OS (Ollama on this computer). sk_notes uses the same connection and the same model as the other SKAI apps: change them in SKAI Manager.
skai.enable-desc: Turn off to hide every AI feature. sk_notes works the same without it.

skai.index-desc: Lets SKAI find relevant notes for questions about the whole vault.
skai.index-no-model: No embedding model installed: questions about the vault use keyword search instead.
skai.memory-off: Not available yet on this system. sk_notes will use it automatically when SKAI provides it.
skai.model-note: SKAI never changes a note without your confirmation, and always shows the changes first.

settings.title-heading-desc: A new note begins with "# Name". Foam, Tolaria and most Markdown apps read the title of a note from that first heading; renaming the note keeps it in step.

pc.plugins.load-failed: The list could not be downloaded: {error}
pc.plugins.up-to-date: Every plugin is up to date.
pc.plugins.restricted-hint: Turn off restricted mode to enable it.

pc.templates.note: Ready-made notes to start from. Click one to add it to your templates folder.
pc.themes.title: Community themes

pc.themes.note: The list comes from the public directory of community themes on GitHub. Click a theme to download and use it. Themes are made by third parties for another app: some may not fit sk_notes perfectly.
pc.sync.title: Sync (GitHub, GitLab)
pc.sync.intro: Keep this vault in a private repository of GitHub, GitLab or your own Git server. sk_notes then sends your changes there and fetches the ones made elsewhere, by itself. On the phone sk_notes for Android, and on other computers Obsidian (with its Git plugin), Foam, Tolaria or Git work on the same notes.
pc.sync.address-desc: The https:// address of the repository.
pc.sync.secret-github: GitHub does not accept the account password from apps: it wants an access token. Press "Create token", sign in, press "Generate token" at the bottom of the page, copy the token and paste it here.
pc.sync.secret-gitlab: An access token (press "Create token"), or your GitLab password if the account has no two-step sign-in.
pc.sync.secret-other: The password or the access token of your account on that server.
pc.sync.repo-desc: Where the notes are kept. Choose the one your PC already uses, or make a new one.
pc.sync.repo-type-desc: Type it as name/repository, or paste its address.
pc.sync.first: Connecting and syncing for the first time…
pc.sync.linked: Connected. This vault is now synced.
pc.sync.offline: No connection: sync resumes when it is back.
pc.sync.linked-intro: This vault is synced with the repository below. Changes are sent a little after you make them and when you close sk_notes; the changes of other devices are fetched when sk_notes opens and at the interval you choose.
pc.sync.auto-desc: Send and fetch changes without asking.
pc.sync.every-desc: How often to look for changes made on other devices while the app is open.
pc.sync.pc-text: On the phone: sk_notes for Android, Settings → Sync, the same repository. On another computer: clone the repository and open its folder with sk_notes, Obsidian (its Git plugin syncs by itself), Foam or Tolaria.
pc.sync.unlink-desc: Stop syncing this vault and forget the password or token kept on this device. Your notes and the repository are not touched.
pc.sync.conflicts:
Notes changed on two devices at once: {n}. The text of this device was saved beside each one:
{list}
pc.sync.too-big:
Files too large to sync (over 50 MB), kept on this device only: {n}
{list}
pc.sync.unwritable:
Files of the repository with names Android cannot store, not copied: {n}
{list}
pc.sync.offer-text: Sync this vault with GitHub or GitLab: a name and a token are enough, then it works by itself. The phone and other computers find the same notes.
pc.sync.encrypted: Sync is not available for an encrypted vault: its notes would be readable on the site.
pc.crypt.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
pc.crypt.option-desc: The whole vault is kept as one encrypted file and asks for a password to open.
pc.crypt.warning: Write down the recovery code shown next: with it a forgotten password can be replaced. Without both, nobody can open the vault, you included. At least 8 characters.
pc.crypt.title: Encryption
pc.crypt.about: This vault is encrypted. It is kept in the file {file}: only what changes is added to it, a few seconds after each change and when sk_notes is closed.
pc.crypt.change-desc: The current password is asked first.
pc.crypt.lock-desc: Save, close the vault and ask for the password again.
pc.crypt.code-text: If you forget the password, this code is the only way to set a new one. Write it down and keep it somewhere safe, away from this computer. It is shown only now.
pc.crypt.recover-text: Type the recovery code you were given when the vault was encrypted, then a new password.
pc.crypt.auto-desc: The vault locks after this time without use (no key pressed, no mouse moved in sk_notes) and asks for the password again. It is always locked when sk_notes is closed.
pc.crypt.new-code-desc: Makes a new code; the old one stops working. The password is asked first.
pc.crypt.no-code-desc: This vault has no recovery code yet (it was made by an older version): make one now.
pc.crypt.decrypt-desc: Turns this vault back into a normal folder of notes, readable by any app. The password is asked first.
pc.crypt.remove-encrypted-confirm: The encrypted file {file} will be deleted. Only the normal folder will be left. Continue?
pc.crypt.encrypt-desc: Keeps this vault as one encrypted file that asks for a password to open. The notes are checked one by one before anything is deleted.
pc.crypt.remove-original-desc: Without this the notes also stay readable in the folder, and encryption protects nothing. If the folder is synced with other devices (Syncthing, Git), it is deleted there too.
pc.crypt.remove-original-confirm: After the encrypted file is made and checked, the folder {folder} will be deleted, with its notes in readable form. Continue?
pc.crypt.torn: The last save of this vault had been cut short: the previous version was opened, and the file was repaired.
pc.crypt.conflicts:
Notes changed here were not saved before the vault file was replaced by another copy. They were kept beside the notes ({n}):
{list}
